How does hybrid search combine keyword a.answer: Hybrid search in Azure AI Search combines keyword and vector search results by merging the two result lists using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) [azure_ai_search.md].

What is the purpose of overlap between c.answer: The purpose of overlap between chunks is to prevent facts from being cut in half at a boundary. This helps maintain the integrity of information when splitting documents into chunks for retrieval and embedding. Overlapping ensures that important context or facts that span chunk boundaries are preserved and not lost or split awkwardly between chunks. This is a trade-off in chunking to balance precision and context retention [rag_concepts.md].
